To lock your phone when performing a gesture, and to open Recents via gesture, Dogo requires accessibility access.

Dogo doesn't watch any user action, though the privilege to do so is required for all accessibility services. Dogo discards any event sent by the system.

In order to lock your phone, or to open Recents, Dogo uses the performGlobalAction Accessibility service.
To access shortcuts and additional features, set Dogo as your default launcher
At a Glance can be manually added to the home screen by placing the Dogo widget
To use Double-Tap to Sleep, set Dogo as a device admin app. Tap \"Open settings\", then tap \"Activate this device admin app.\"
